seo.title: About David Sandoval — Software Engineer
seo.description: About David Sandoval, a backend-oriented Software Engineer with hands-on frontend experience across product systems, integrations, developer tooling and software-maintenance research.

summary: Backend-oriented Software Engineer with hands-on frontend experience. I work on product systems across backend services, frontend features, and integrations. When behavior changes or a problem crosses layers, I trace the affected flow before making the change.
biography: I work mainly on backend services with .NET and also build frontend features with Angular and TypeScript. My day-to-day work spans APIs, integrations and existing product workflows, so I often need to understand how a change affects more than one part of the system.

At Atena, I work on .NET backend services and an Angular administrative frontend in an existing fintech product. My work includes API, authorization, integration and frontend changes. When a change crosses layers or services, I trace the affected flow and consumers, then use tests, compiler feedback and static analysis to validate regression-prone behavior.

Outside work, I build developer tools and product projects, and I’m developing my thesis on vulnerable-dependency remediation in OSS ecosystems. My original thesis direction changed after the literature review, so I’m now validating the new question and data before choosing a model.
availabilityStatement: Open to remote software engineering opportunities, including international roles or relocation; I’m also exploring graduate study.
researchSummary: Researching whether upstream maintenance signals add useful prospective information for estimating vulnerable-dependency remediation latency; the final outcome definition and model family remain under validation.
currentRoleSummary: I currently work at Atena as a Jr. Software Engineer, mainly on .NET backend services and also on an Angular administrative frontend. My work includes API, authorization, service-integration and frontend changes, with targeted validation for regression-prone behavior.
